title: Penang Curry Paste
description: Homemade approximation of the HelloFresh sachet. No published ingredient list could be found, so this is a sensible copycat. One batch replaces one sachet.

steps.text: Mix into a paste and fry for 1 minute before adding coconut milk. Choose a red curry paste without shrimp paste. Use the whole batch wherever the recipe calls for 1 sachet.
